entities.summary: Zuriel Oduwole is an American education advocate, policy advisor, and filmmaker. Born to British parents of Mauritanian and Nigerian ancestry in Los Angeles, California, Oduwole was first featured in a Forbes magazine in 2010 at the age of 10. In November 2014, Zuriel became the youngest filmmaker to self-produce and edit a screened work for the movie theater and was featured by CNBC.
